title: orGAN: A Synthetic Data Augmentation Pipeline for Simultaneous Generation of Surgical Images and Ground Truth Labels
abstract: arXiv:2506.14303v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning for surgical image analysis is constrained by limited data diversity, ethical restrictions, high acquisition costs, and the scarcity of accurately annotated bleeding datasets, making reliable bleeding localization particularly challenging. To address these limitations, we propose orGAN, a modular framework that generates realistic, fully annotated synthetic surgical bleeding images together with recoverable point-level supervision. To overcome the ethical and cost barriers of real surgical data, the pipeline is trained on silicone-based mimicking organs that reproduce tissue properties, using an enhanced StyleGAN3 generator coupled with Relational Positional Learning to embed bleeding coordinates, a Surgical Label Detection Algorithm to recover coordinate and mask labels, and a fine-tuned LaMa inpainting network to restore clean image-label pairs. translated_title: orGAN：一种可同时生成手术图像与真实标注标签的合成数据增强流水线
translated_abstract: 深度学习在手术图像分析中的应用受到数据多样性有限、伦理限制、高采集成本以及准确标注的出血数据集稀缺等问题的制约，这使得可靠的出血定位尤为困难。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了orGAN——一个模块化框架，能够生成逼真的、完全标注的合成手术出血图像，并同时提供可恢复的点级监督标签。为了克服真实手术数据带来的伦理与成本障碍，该流水线基于再现组织特性的硅胶模拟器官进行训练，采用增强的StyleGAN3生成器结合关系位置学习来嵌入出血坐标，利用手术标签检测算法恢复坐标与掩膜标签，并通过微调的LaMa图像修复网络还原干净的图像-标签对。为了弥补标注数据的稀缺，出血警报图定位
tldr: 该论文提出orGAN框架，通过在硅胶模拟器官上训练增强的StyleGAN3生成器、关系位置学习与LaMa修复网络，实现手术出血图像与点级真实标注标签的同步生成，从而克服手术数据稀缺、伦理限制与高标注成本等问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes orGAN, a modular framework that synchronously generates realistic surgical bleeding images with recoverable point-level ground truth labels by training on silicone-based mimicking organs with an enhanced StyleGAN3 generator, Relational Positional Learning, and fine-tuned LaMa inpainting, addressing data scarcity, ethical constraints, and high annotation costs in surgical image analysis.
